newsitem.title: USA: Tiffany earnings jump 75 pct; stock gains.
newsitem.headline: Tiffany earnings jump 75 pct; stock gains.

text.p: Tiffany & Co. Wednesday reported a 75 percent jump in profits on a 10 percent rise in sales, which sparked a runup in its stock.
The upscale jeweller said its earnings rose to $8.8 million, equal to 25 cents a share in its fiscal first quarter ended April 30, up from year-earlier profits of $5.0 million, or 15 cents a share.
Sales rose to $199.7 million from $180.8 million.
Tiffany said U.S. sales rose 9 percent to $87.8 million on a 7 percent rise in same-store sales.
International sales jumped 17 percent to $95.2 million on gains in all regions.
In Japan, Tiffany's largest international market, total retail sales were up 50 percent in local currency, but they rose only 29 percent when translated in U.S. dollars.
Tiffany's stock was up $1.625 to $45 on the New York Stock Exchange.
